m_dda2a508fd7b.zh-Hant: 雙方按下「準備就緒」後繼續，暫停最長 60 秒。

m_59220f8da0e2.en: Create a fresh invitation when you are ready.
m_59220f8da0e2.zh-Hant: 準備好時，請建立新的邀請。

m_d666c6c98942.en: Private casual result · both players can Ready for a rematch.
m_d666c6c98942.zh-Hant: 私人休閒對局成績 · 雙方可準備重賽。

m_8ededd3d6c70.en: Play is paused. Reconnect within 15 seconds.
m_8ededd3d6c70.zh-Hant: 遊戲已暫停，請在 15 秒內重新連線。

m_97ed95b7c41a.en: Sign in with Google to play online.
m_97ed95b7c41a.zh-Hant: 使用 Google 登入即可線上遊玩。

m_8c7f619180a2.en: Account changed. Reopen Pong before joining.
m_8c7f619180a2.zh-Hant: 帳號已變更，加入前請重新開啟 Pong。

m_0cc1b60d325e.en: Room service is unavailable. Retry when connected.
m_0cc1b60d325e.zh-Hant: 房間服務無法使用，連線恢復後請重試。

m_6803ddcb7d8c.en: The private connection timed out. Retry to reconnect.
m_6803ddcb7d8c.zh-Hant: 私人連線逾時，請重試以重新連線。

m_68d49a90abc0.en: Share the room link. Both players press Ready to begin.
m_68d49a90abc0.zh-Hant: 請分享房間連結，雙方按下「準備就緒」即可開始。

m_b151aeafaf1c.en: Match ready. Move your paddle on the court.
m_b151aeafaf1c.zh-Hant: 對局已就緒，在球場內移動你的擋板。

m_b0e064cc2e89.en: Ready sent. Waiting for your friend.
m_b0e064cc2e89.zh-Hant: 已送出準備狀態，正在等待好友。

m_b8c0dadaf00e.en: You left the room. Create or join a new one.
m_b8c0dadaf00e.zh-Hant: 你已離開房間，可建立或加入新房間。

m_ad2173cac3cd.en: Enable drawing or try another browser.
m_ad2173cac3cd.zh-Hant: 請啟用繪圖功能，或使用其他瀏覽器。

m_7ebd63bbd922.en: Leave this online room? The current match will close for both players.
m_7ebd63bbd922.zh-Hant: 離開此線上房間嗎？目前對局將為雙方一同關閉。

m_e2249e1ffc87.en: Invite link copied. Your friend signs in, joins, then presses Ready.
m_e2249e1ffc87.zh-Hant: 邀請連結已複製。好友登入、加入後，再按下「準備就緒」。

m_ebfd15fc3e4e.en: Account changed. Create or join a fresh room.
m_ebfd15fc3e4e.zh-Hant: 帳號已變更，請建立或加入新的房間。

m_087c86af7299.en: Create a room or enter your friend's invitation code.
m_087c86af7299.zh-Hant: 建立房間，或輸入好友的邀請代碼。

m_5a5978926e0a.en: Sign in with Google to create or join a room.
m_5a5978926e0a.zh-Hant: 使用 Google 登入即可建立或加入房間。

m_e8513b8ca4d1.zh-Hant: 不能變更謎題的已知數字。

m_798ac517d08c.en: This is a given digit. Select an empty cell.
m_798ac517d08c.zh-Hant: 這是已知數字，請選擇空格。

m_57cbaa7b365a.en: Erase the digit before adding pencil notes.
m_57cbaa7b365a.zh-Hant: 請先清除數字，再加入鉛筆筆記。

m_9ef8f65ad4a3.en: Sudoku puzzle, use arrow keys to select a cell
m_9ef8f65ad4a3.zh-Hant: 數獨謎題，使用方向鍵選擇格子

m_d325a99b00c8.en: Select a cell, then enter 1–9. Arrow keys move; Delete erases; N toggles notes. Conflicts show an underline.
m_d325a99b00c8.zh-Hant: 選擇格子後輸入 1–9。方向鍵移動；Delete 清除；N 切換筆記。衝突處會顯示底線。

m_beb8cfd380fb.en: Drag cells to paint; select the same mark to erase. Swipe the clues or scroll to move a large board. Arrows move; Space fills; X marks empty. A check means the visible runs match the clues.
m_beb8cfd380fb.zh-Hant: 拖曳格子即可填色；選擇相同標記可清除。滑動線索或捲動可移動大型棋盤。方向鍵移動；Space 填色；X 標空。勾號表示目前可見的連續格數符合線索。

m_17f6bc7b3354.en: Start or resume this puzzle before using a hint.
m_17f6bc7b3354.zh-Hant: 請先開始或繼續此謎題，再使用提示。

m_c0c38ab1fd8e.en: Hints are available in Private games only.
m_c0c38ab1fd8e.zh-Hant: 僅私人遊戲可使用提示。

m_148f591c669c.zh-Hant: 已在第 {0} 行、第 {1} 欄套用提示。

m_ee2f41c6c76c.en: Sign in to start a Public game.
m_ee2f41c6c76c.zh-Hant: 登入即可開始公開對局。

m_00c080715a4e.zh-Hant: 帳號已變更，請重新開啟此遊戲。

m_3331838f8500.en: Public service could not complete this request. Check your connection and retry.
m_3331838f8500.zh-Hant: 公開對局服務無法完成此請求，請檢查連線後重試。

m_55eee794d37a.en: Could not preserve this Public result locally. Keep this page open to retry.
m_55eee794d37a.zh-Hant: 無法在本機保留此公開成績，請保持此頁開啟以重試。

m_abf84f037af7.en: Public result storage failed. Keep this page open to retry.
m_abf84f037af7.zh-Hant: 公開成績儲存失敗，請保持此頁開啟以重試。

m_95fe4be17473.en: Clear a board. Beat your best. Take a breather.
m_95fe4be17473.zh-Hant: 清空棋盤，突破紀錄，讓自己歇一會。

m_44be3293f9bd.en: Twelve little challenges. One more personal best.
m_44be3293f9bd.zh-Hant: 十二個小挑戰，再創一次個人最佳。

m_4a2ceced9b91.zh-Hant: 小歇片刻，也要玩得精彩。

m_ff126a5f7bd1.zh-Hant: 自在遊玩，留下最佳紀錄。

m_1c7440e4c1c2.en: Slide, merge and find a little room for one more tile.
m_1c7440e4c1c2.zh-Hant: 滑動、合併，再為下一個方塊騰出一點空間。

m_29b17813ee24.en: Read the numbers. Trust your flags. Clear a careful path.
m_29b17813ee24.zh-Hant: 看懂數字，相信旗幟，小心開出安全路線。

m_4d015521f7b3.en: One more bite, one less corner. A familiar little challenge.
m_4d015521f7b3.zh-Hant: 多吃一口，少一個轉角。熟悉的小挑戰，等你再試一次。

m_f68ddcfec790.en: A few familiar shapes. A little more attention.
m_f68ddcfec790.zh-Hant: 幾個熟悉的圖案，再多一點專注。

m_b5e141367af6.en: A little logic, one number at a time. Notes, hints and three difficulties.
m_b5e141367af6.zh-Hant: 一次一個數字，慢慢推理。提供筆記、提示與三種難度。

m_25add22265f7.en: Follow the clues. Fill the squares. Reveal a little pixel picture.
m_25add22265f7.zh-Hant: 跟隨線索，填滿方格，揭開小小的像素圖。

m_051f8c8eb06f.en: Find a place for every shape. Fill a line and make a little space.
m_051f8c8eb06f.zh-Hant: 替每個形狀找到位置，填滿一行，再騰出一點空間。

m_0e15ba7033d3.en: Keep the ball in play. Three stages, three lives, one more bounce.
m_0e15ba7033d3.zh-Hant: 讓球持續在場。三個關卡、三條生命，再多一次反彈。

m_ab5c1158b9c8.en: Four in a row, a move ahead. Play the computer or share a screen.
m_ab5c1158b9c8.zh-Hant: 四子連線，先想一步。可挑戰電腦，也可與朋友共用畫面。

m_4a3622572a91.en: A quiet move can turn the board. Play the computer or a friend beside you.
m_4a3622572a91.zh-Hant: 安靜的一步，也能翻轉棋盤。挑戰電腦，或與身旁好友對弈。

m_c1ec406ac5bc.en: Find your stack rhythm. Clear a line, chase forty, hold your next move.
m_c1ec406ac5bc.zh-Hant: 找到堆疊節奏。消除一行、挑戰四十行，再保留下一步。

m_04658dee2bcb.en: A friend on the other side.

m_4d4f3cd82221.en: Invite a friend. Share a rally. A private online room for two.
m_4d4f3cd82221.zh-Hant: 邀請好友，一起接球。專屬兩人的私人線上房間。

m_ada628bc5416.en: No games found. Try another search.
m_ada628bc5416.zh-Hant: 找不到遊戲，請換個關鍵字。

m_266d5342c55f.zh-Hant: 正在載入已驗證公開成績…

m_7a3ad2d4b176.zh-Hant: 從上次停下的地方繼續

m_45b15219c9b5.en: No unfinished games yet. Pick a game above.
m_45b15219c9b5.zh-Hant: 目前沒有未完成的遊戲，請選擇上方遊戲。

m_15a063a065b5.zh-Hant: 將遊客存檔複製至帳號

m_5b7f29662bd3.en: Guest games stay on this device. Account saves are private. Only verified Public results appear on leaderboards.
m_5b7f29662bd3.zh-Hant: 遊客遊戲保留在此裝置，帳號存檔為私人資料。只有經驗證的公開成績會顯示於排行榜。

m_55bdaf01ab6f.zh-Hant: 每位玩家只列出一筆驗證最佳成績。

m_5df33f98504d.en: Verified results only. Your best on this device may differ.
m_5df33f98504d.zh-Hant: 僅列出驗證成績，你在此裝置的最佳紀錄可能不同。

m_67103200d43a.en: Preferences stay on this device. Playing continues while these settings are open.
m_67103200d43a.zh-Hant: 偏好保留在此裝置。開啟設定時，遊戲仍會繼續。

m_73ec5b270dac.en: Play continues while this menu is open. Pausing or opening Help makes a ranked run local only.
m_73ec5b270dac.zh-Hant: 開啟此選單時，遊戲仍會繼續。暫停或開啟說明，會使參榜對局轉為僅限本機。

m_be22bb04d272.en: Only verified Public runs unlock milestones.
m_be22bb04d272.zh-Hant: 只有經驗證的公開對局能解鎖里程碑。

m_893c9fd1223a.en: Use arrow keys, WASD, swipe, or the direction buttons. Equal tiles merge once per move; their new value adds to your score. New tiles are 2 (90%) or 4 (10%). Reaching 2048 is a milestone: keep playing until no moves remain. One-step Undo is available during local-only play.
m_893c9fd1223a.zh-Hant: 使用方向鍵、WASD、滑動或方向按鈕操作。相同方塊每次移動只能合併一次，合併後的數值會加入分數。新方塊有 90% 機率為 2、10% 為 4。達到 2048 是一個里程碑，之後可繼續遊玩，直到無法移動。僅限本機遊玩時可復原一步。

m_a81ded35061e.en: Controls work while the board is focused. Progress saves automatically. Signed-in new games submit eligible results after verification. Paused, interrupted or restored games are local only. Restart to change a locked mode or difficulty.
m_a81ded35061e.zh-Hant: 棋盤聚焦時可使用控制鍵。進度會自動儲存。登入後開始的新對局，符合資格的成績會在驗證後提交。暫停、中斷或從存檔恢復的遊戲僅限本機。要更改已鎖定的模式或難度，請重新開始。

m_b23842a40db1.en: Save failed? Keep this page open and retry sync. Guest saves stay separate from account saves. Sound starts only after your action. Sound and volume preferences stay on this device.
m_b23842a40db1.zh-Hant: 儲存失敗？請保持此頁開啟並重試同步。遊客存檔與帳號存檔分開保留。只有在你操作後才會啟動聲音，聲音與音量偏好保留於此裝置。

m_fce9b3e351e0.en: Stack seven kinds of falling pieces on a 10 × 20 board. Left/right or A/D move; Up/X rotates clockwise, Z counterclockwise, Down/S soft-drops, Space hard-drops, C/Shift holds once per piece. SRS wall kicks, seven-piece bags, a ghost and three-piece preview are included. Clear 1/2/3/4 lines for 100/300/500/800 × level; soft drop adds 1 per cell and hard drop 2. Every 10 lines increases level. Classic ends when the stack reaches the top. Sprint ranks completed 40-line runs by server time. Paused and restored games are local only.
m_fce9b3e351e0.zh-Hant: 在 10 × 20 棋盤堆疊七種下落方塊。左右鍵或 A／D 移動；上鍵／X 順時針旋轉，Z 逆時針旋轉；下鍵／S 軟降，Space 硬降，C／Shift 保留，每個方塊限一次。提供 SRS 踢牆旋轉、七種方塊一袋的隨機序列、落點投影及接下來三塊預覽。一次消除 1／2／3／4 行，分別獲得 100／300／500／800 × 等級的分數；軟降每格加 1 分，硬降每格加 2 分。每消除 10 行升一級。經典模式在方塊堆至頂部時結束；衝刺模式以伺服器時間排列完成 40 行的成績。暫停或恢復存檔後，遊戲僅限本機。

m_65e351ccf1b1.en: Place each of the three shapes, then receive a new tray. Tap a shape and a board square, or drag it into place. The selected square is the shape’s top-left corner. Arrow keys move the placement cursor; Enter places. Full rows and columns clear together. Each placed cell earns 1 point, each cleared line 10. Shapes cannot rotate. The game ends when none of the remaining shapes fits.
m_65e351ccf1b1.zh-Hant: 放置三個形狀後，會取得新的一組。先點選形狀再點棋盤格，或直接拖曳放置。選擇的格子代表形狀左上角。方向鍵可移動放置游標，Enter 放置。填滿的行與欄會同時消除。每放置一格得 1 分，每消除一行或一欄得 10 分。形狀不能旋轉。剩餘形狀皆無處可放時，遊戲結束。

m_51b329042c0b.en: Move the paddle with your pointer, touch, arrow keys or A / D. Catch ×3 Multiball, ↔ Wide Paddle (12 seconds), and ¾ Slow Ball (8 seconds) drops. Only losing all active balls costs a life. New games use powerup rules v2; old saves use Legacy rules. Tap Launch or press Space to serve. Break each brick for 10 points; clear three stages using three shared lives. A new ball waits for your launch after a miss. The five-minute active-play limit includes waiting to launch. Only natural endings, time limit or all three cleared stages finish ranked runs.
m_51b329042c0b.zh-Hant: 使用游標、觸控、方向鍵或 A／D 移動擋板。接住掉落的 ×3 多球、↔ 加寬擋板（12 秒）及 ¾ 慢速球（8 秒）。只有全部場上球掉落才扣一條生命。新遊戲使用強化道具 v2 規則，舊存檔沿用舊版規則。點按「發球」或按 Space 發球。每塊磚得 10 分，共用三條生命挑戰三關。失球後，新球會等待你發射。五分鐘的遊玩時限包含等待發球的時間。只有自然結束、時間到或完成全部三關，才算完成參榜對局。

m_4b305550925a.en: Play the computer or a friend on this device. These matches stay Private, with saved progress and Undo.
m_4b305550925a.zh-Hant: 可挑戰電腦，或與好友在此裝置對弈。對局保持私人，支援儲存進度與復原。

m_cc52667c6f4f.en: Computer thinking stops when you pause or leave.
m_cc52667c6f4f.zh-Hant: 暫停或離開時，電腦會停止思考。

m_bd92581cd7c4.en: Drop a piece into one of seven columns. Connect four horizontally, vertically or diagonally to win. A full board without a winner is a draw. Choose three computer difficulties or two players on this device. Choose first or second before starting. Local only: pause, continue and undo your last human turn (one move for two players).
m_bd92581cd7c4.zh-Hant: 將棋子投入七欄中的其中一欄。橫向、直向或斜向連成四子即可獲勝。棋盤填滿仍無人獲勝則為平局。提供三種電腦難度，或在此裝置雙人對弈。開始前可選擇先手或後手。僅限本機遊玩，可暫停、繼續及復原上一次玩家回合；雙人模式則復原一步。

m_791fe34d0357.en: Select two cards to find a matching pair. Each pair of flips counts as one attempt. A mismatch stays visible for 650 ms; wait before trying again. Match every pair to finish. Fewer attempts rank first, then faster completion.
m_791fe34d0357.zh-Hant: 選擇兩張卡牌，找出相同圖案。每翻開兩張計為一次嘗試。配對失敗時會顯示 650 毫秒，請等待後再試。配對全部卡牌即可完成。排行榜先比較嘗試次數，次數較少者優先；再比較完成時間。

m_dfe01bc7acf6.en: Reveal every safe square to win. Your first reveal and its neighbors are safe. Right-click to flag; on touch use Reveal / Flag. Activate an already-open number to reveal its neighbors when the surrounding flag count matches. Incorrect flags can lose the game. Random boards may require a guess. Large boards pan inside the game area.
m_dfe01bc7acf6.zh-Hant: 揭開全部安全格即可獲勝。首次揭開的格子及相鄰格均安全。按滑鼠右鍵插旗；觸控裝置可切換「揭開／插旗」。當周圍旗幟數與數字相符時，再次點按已揭開的數字，可揭開相鄰格。插錯旗可能導致失敗。隨機棋盤有時需要猜測。大型棋盤可在遊戲區內平移。

m_bcf62483731c.en: The numbers show consecutive filled runs in each row and column, in order. Separate runs with at least one empty square. Switch Fill / Mark or use X to mark an empty square; drag to paint. A matching clue line is highlighted. Scroll the clue area to pan larger boards. Local-only play provides Undo and a one-cell Hint. Only a completed ranked puzzle can rank.
m_bcf62483731c.zh-Hant: 數字依序表示每行、每欄連續填色格的長度。每段之間至少留一個空格。切換「填色／標空」，或使用 X 標記空格；拖曳可連續填色。符合的線索行會亮起。捲動線索區可平移大型棋盤。僅限本機遊玩時，提供復原及單格提示。只有完成的參榜謎題才能上榜。

m_ecfb42853be5.en: Online Pong court. Move your paddle with pointer, touch or up and down keys.
m_ecfb42853be5.zh-Hant: 線上 Pong 球場。使用游標、觸控或上下鍵移動擋板。

m_3f69ee16107d.en: No game traffic before joining a room.
m_3f69ee16107d.zh-Hant: 加入房間前，不會產生遊戲流量。

m_47110fe6ce4a.en: A wider court plays best in landscape. Drag on the court to move your paddle.
m_47110fe6ce4a.zh-Hant: 橫向畫面有更寬的球場，遊玩體驗較佳。在球場內拖曳即可移動擋板。

m_418fc2a85bb7.en: Both players sign in with Google. Two rooms can be open at a time. Waiting rooms expire after 15 minutes.
m_418fc2a85bb7.zh-Hant: 雙方均需使用 Google 登入。同時最多開放兩個房間，等待中的房間會在 15 分鐘後失效。

m_48dcdef6901a.en: Both players press Ready to start or resume.
m_48dcdef6901a.zh-Hant: 雙方按下「準備就緒」即可開始或繼續。

m_bb32dab144ce.en: First to 7 wins. After 10 minutes, the higher score wins; equal scores draw.
m_bb32dab144ce.zh-Hant: 先得 7 分者獲勝。10 分鐘後以較高分者獲勝，同分則為平局。

m_0860f7f9f3d1.en: Switching away pauses the match. Reconnect within 15 seconds after a lost connection.
m_0860f7f9f3d1.zh-Hant: 切離頁面會暫停對局。連線中斷後，請在 15 秒內重新連線。

m_831e961b4837.en: A pause lasts up to 60 seconds. Online matches are temporary and do not enter Continue playing.
m_831e961b4837.zh-Hant: 暫停最長 60 秒。線上對局為暫時性，不會進入「繼續遊玩」。

m_77589a89264b.en: This casual room has no Public rank or achievements.
m_77589a89264b.zh-Hant: 此休閒房間不提供公開排名或成就。

m_8657858ce063.en: Move the pointer, drag, or focus the court and use ↑ / ↓ or W / S. First to 7 points.
m_8657858ce063.zh-Hant: 移動游標、拖曳，或將焦點移至球場後使用 ↑／↓ 或 W／S。先得 7 分者獲勝。

m_27741794fd48.en: Black plays first. Place a disc on a marked legal square to enclose and flip opponent discs along a row, column or diagonal. The opponent is skipped automatically if no move is legal. When neither player can move, the larger disc count wins; equal counts draw. Choose a computer difficulty or two local players. Local only, with save and Undo.
m_27741794fd48.zh-Hant: 黑棋先手。在有標記的合法格放置棋子，沿行、欄或斜線夾住對手棋子並將其翻轉。若對手沒有合法落子，會自動跳過其回合。雙方都無法落子時，棋子較多者獲勝，同數則為平局。可選擇電腦難度，或在本機雙人對弈。僅限本機遊玩，支援儲存與復原。

m_0a921e08f9a6.en: Use arrow keys, WASD, swipe, or the direction buttons. Each food adds 10 points and one segment. Avoid walls and your own body; filling the board wins. Slow, Normal and Fast use 6, 10 and 14 cells per second. Direction changes are accepted once per game tick.
m_0a921e08f9a6.zh-Hant: 使用方向鍵、WASD、滑動或方向按鈕。每份食物增加 10 分及一節身體。避開牆壁與自己的身體，填滿棋盤即可獲勝。慢速、一般、快速分別為每秒 6、10、14 格。每個遊戲邏輯步只能接受一次轉向。

m_2197af1586b5.en: Fill each row, column and 3 × 3 box with digits 1–9. Select a cell and use the number pad or keyboard. Pencil notes are available in either mode. Conflicts show duplicates, not hidden answers. Local-only play provides one-step Undo and a one-cell Hint. Complete a ranked puzzle without hints or interruption to enter its difficulty board.
m_2197af1586b5.zh-Hant: 在每行、每欄與每個 3 × 3 宮填入數字 1–9。選擇格子後，使用數字面板或鍵盤輸入。兩種模式都可使用鉛筆筆記。衝突提示只顯示重複數字，不會透露答案。僅限本機遊玩時提供復原一步及單格提示。完成參榜謎題，且未使用提示或中斷，才能進入該難度的排行榜。
